summary: Full end-to-end test of Réntalo en Línea. Backend 16/16 pytest passing (auth, properties, applications+risk, approval->contract, contract activation, Stripe rent checkout, dashboard stats). Frontend flow verified: landing, /explorar filters, tenant + landlord logins, sidebar navigation, protected /panel redirect, received application visible with risk score, active contract card rendered.

issues: Browser tab title is default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'Réntalo en Línea' branding

action_items: (Optional / minor) Update /app/frontend/public/index.html <title> and meta to Réntalo en Línea branding.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 780 lines in a single file – consider modularizing into routers/services for maintainability.
Seed only creates admin/demo users if they don't exist – if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes, existing admin won't be updated (idempotent-with-password-refresh recommended per auth playbook).
compute_risk() rules are simple by design – documented as such; OK for MVP.
Google session endpoint stores session_token from Emergent as-is; already works with cookie/Bearer paths.
All endpoints properly exclude Mongo _id via projections and clean_user().
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 properties + 3 demo users on startup. During tests: created 1 landlord property (deleted after), 1 tenant application on 'Estudio luminoso en Roma Norte' that was approved -> contract auto-generated and activated. Tenant demo now has 1 application, 1 active contract at $16,000/mes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo tenant already has an active contract on 'Estudio luminoso en Roma Norte' (prop marked 'en_proceso'/'rentado'). Further application creation on same property by same tenant will 400 with 'Ya tienes una solicitud activa'. Use another property or new tenant for rerunning application flow. Stripe checkout tested up to checkout_url creation (no card submission).
